difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma with six assertions: an algebraic space X that is separated, locally separated or quasi-separated (absolutely, or over S) has the corresponding property as a morphism, and any morphism f : X -> Y over S is then separated, locally separated or quasi-separated (source lines 657-671). The proof derives parts (4), (5) and (6) from the composition statement applied to the structure morphism of X, and parts (1), (2) and (3) from (4), (5) and (6) by viewing X and Y as algebraic spaces over Spec(Z).
